examplePinyin: Tāmen wèi yí jiàn xiǎo shì zhēngbiànle bàntiān。
exampleEn: They argued for ages over a trivial matter.
cloze: 他们为一件小事＿＿了半天。

en: to vie with one another; to rush to be first
exampleZh: 车一停，人们争先恐后地上了车。
examplePinyin: Chē yì tíng， rén men zhēngxiān-kǒnghòu de shàngle chē。
exampleEn: As soon as the bus stopped, people rushed to get on.

exampleZh: 他的房间总是很整洁。
examplePinyin: Tā de fángjiān zǒngshì hěn zhěngjié。
exampleEn: His room is always neat and clean.

exampleZh: 他是个正经人，每天认真工作。
examplePinyin: Tā shì gè zhèngjing rén， měi tiān rènzhēn gōngzuò。
exampleEn: He is a decent person who works hard every day.
cloze: 他是个＿＿人，每天认真工作。

en: just; feel free to; by all means
exampleZh: 你有问题只管问我。
examplePinyin: Nǐ yǒu wèntí zhǐguǎn wèn wǒ。
exampleEn: If you have questions, just ask me.

en: to place; to put; to set up
exampleZh: 他把书置在桌子的一边。
examplePinyin: Tā bǎ shū zhì zài zhuōzi de yìbiān。
exampleEn: He placed the books on one side of the table.

exampleZh: 他给我一个忠告：早点休息。
examplePinyin: Tā gěi wǒ yí gè zhōnggào： zǎo diǎn xiūxi。
exampleEn: He gave me a piece of advice: rest earlier.

exampleZh: 墙上的钟停了。
examplePinyin: Qiáng shàng de zhōng tíngle。
exampleEn: The clock on the wall has stopped.

en: wrinkle; crease; to wrinkle; to frown
exampleZh: 这件衣服上有很多皱。
examplePinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu shàng yǒu hěn duō zhòu。
exampleEn: There are many wrinkles on this piece of clothing.

exampleZh: 他用竹竿把衣服挂了起来。
examplePinyin: Tā yòng zhúgān bǎ yīfu guàle qǐlái。
exampleEn: He used a bamboo pole to hang up the clothes.

exampleZh: 我在这里找到了新的住处。
examplePinyin: Wǒ zài zhèlǐ zhǎo dàole xīn de zhùchù。
exampleEn: I found a new place to live here.

exampleZh: 这栋楼有三十多户住户。
examplePinyin: Zhè dòng lóu yǒu sān shí duō hù zhùhù。
exampleEn: This building has more than thirty households.

en: to pour; to inject; (of money) stake; note
exampleZh: 请往杯子里注一点热水。
examplePinyin: Qǐng wǎng bēizi lǐ zhù yì diǎn rè shuǐ。
exampleEn: Please pour a little hot water into the cup.

en: to gaze at; to watch closely
exampleZh: 她注视着窗外的雨。
examplePinyin: Tā zhùshìzhe chuāng wài de yǔ。
exampleEn: She gazed at the rain outside the window.

en: to pull; to drag; to tug
exampleZh: 他拽着我的衣服不放手。
examplePinyin: Tā zhuàizhe wǒ de yīfu bú fàng shǒu。
exampleEn: He held on to my clothes and wouldn't let go.

en: to make a special trip; specially for the purpose
exampleZh: 他专程来我家看我。
examplePinyin: Tā zhuānchéng lái wǒ jiā kàn wǒ。
exampleEn: He made a special trip to my home to see me.

en: to pass on (a message); to relay
exampleZh: 请把我的话转达给他。
examplePinyin: Qǐng bǎ wǒ dehuà zhuǎndá gěi tā。
exampleEn: Please pass my words on to him.

en: a turn for the better; a favorable turn (in a situation)
exampleZh: 事情终于有了转机。
examplePinyin: Shìqing zhōngyú yǒule zhuǎnjī。
exampleEn: The situation finally took a turn for the better.

exampleZh: 那次谈话成了他人生的转折点。
examplePinyin: Nà cì tánhuà chéngle tā rénshēng de zhuǎnzhédiǎn。
exampleEn: That conversation became the turning point in his life.
cloze: 那次谈话成了他人生的＿＿。

en: to stroll around; to wander about
exampleZh: 我们下午在街上转悠了半天。
examplePinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ zài jiē shàng zhuànyoule bàntiān。
exampleEn: We wandered around the street all afternoon.
cloze: 我们下午在街上＿＿了半天。

exampleZh: 门口立着一桩木头。
examplePinyin: Ménkǒu lìzhe yì zhuāng mùtou。
exampleEn: A wooden stake stands at the doorway.

en: to chase after; to catch up with
exampleZh: 小狗在草地上追赶一只鸟。
examplePinyin: Xiǎo gǒu zài cǎodì shàng zhuīgǎn yì zhī niǎo。
exampleEn: The puppy is chasing a bird on the grass.

en: to chase; to pursue; to seek
exampleZh: 孩子们在公园里互相追逐。
examplePinyin: Háizi men zài gōngyuán lǐ hùxiāng zhuīzhú。
exampleEn: The children are chasing each other in the park.

en: whereabouts; a definite place or source; settlement
exampleZh: 他的住处还没有着落。
examplePinyin: Tā de zhùchù hái méiyǒu zhuóluò。
exampleEn: There is still no definite place for him to live.

exampleZh: 他开车很自如，一点也不紧张。
examplePinyin: Tā kāichē hěn zìrú， yì diǎn yě bù jǐnzhāng。
exampleEn: He drives with ease and isn't nervous at all.
cloze: 他开车很＿＿，一点也不紧张。

en: to stay indoors; never to leave home
exampleZh: 下雨天他足不出户，在家看书。
examplePinyin: Xià yǔ tiān tā zúbùchūhù， zài jiā kàn shū。
exampleEn: On rainy days he stays indoors and reads at home.

en: to stop; to block; to hinder
exampleZh: 他要去，你就别阻拦他了。
examplePinyin: Tā yào qù， nǐ jiù bié zǔlán tāle。
exampleEn: If he wants to go, don't stop him.

exampleZh: 他一直在琢磨这个问题。
examplePinyin: Tā yìzhí zài zuómo zhège wèntí。
exampleEn: He has been thinking over this problem all along.

en: to look around; to glance left and right
exampleZh: 她站在门口左顾右盼，像在等人。
examplePinyin: Tā zhàn zài ménkǒu zuǒgù-yòupàn， xiàng zài děng rén。
exampleEn: She stood at the door looking around, as if waiting for someone.

en: to become invalid; to cancel; to void
exampleZh: 这张票过期就作废了。
examplePinyin: Zhè zhāng piào guòqī jiù zuòfèile。
exampleEn: This ticket becomes invalid once it expires.

en: to be a guest; to visit as a guest
exampleZh: 周末我们去朋友家作客。
examplePinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen qù péngyou jiā zuòkè。
exampleEn: On the weekend we go to a friend's home as guests.

en: to decide; to take charge; to have the final say
exampleZh: 这件事你来做主吧。
examplePinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ lái zuòzhǔ ba。
exampleEn: You decide this matter.

en: to be overwhelmed by a favor; to feel flattered and surprised
exampleZh: 听说您亲自来，我真是受宠若惊。
examplePinyin: Tīngshuō nín qīnzì lái， wǒ zhēnshi shòuchǒng-ruòjīng。
exampleEn: Hearing that you're coming in person, I'm truly flattered.

en: to be frightened; to get a shock
exampleZh: 小狗受惊了，一直躲在桌子下面。
examplePinyin: Xiǎo gǒu shòujīngle， yìzhí duǒ zài zhuōzi xiàmiàn。
exampleEn: The puppy got frightened and kept hiding under the table.
cloze: 小狗＿＿了，一直躲在桌子下面。

exampleZh: 听完他的笑话，我心里很舒畅。
examplePinyin: Tīng wán tā de xiàohua， wǒ xīnlǐ hěn shūchàng。
exampleEn: After hearing his joke, I felt very relaxed and happy.
cloze: 听完他的笑话，我心里很＿＿。

en: distant; to become distant; to drift apart
exampleZh: 他们多年不见，关系疏远了。
examplePinyin: Tāmen duō nián bújiàn， guānxì shūyuǎnle。
exampleEn: They hadn't seen each other for years, and their relationship drifted apart.

en: to act shamelessly; to play dirty; to go back on one's word
exampleZh: 输了就耍赖，大家都不愿意跟他玩。
examplePinyin: Shūle jiù shuǎlài， dàjiā dōu bú yuànyì gēn tā wán。
exampleEn: He acts shamelessly when he loses, so nobody wants to play with him.
cloze: 输了就＿＿，大家都不愿意跟他玩。

exampleZh: 他性格爽快，说话很直接。
examplePinyin: Tā xìnggé shuǎngkuai， shuōhuà hěn zhíjiē。
exampleEn: He has a straightforward personality and speaks very directly.

en: let nature take its course; go with the flow
exampleZh: 这件事别太着急，顺其自然吧。
examplePinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bié tài zháojí， shùnqízìrán ba。
exampleEn: Don't worry too much about this; just let it be.

en: to lie; to tell a lie
exampleZh: 他从来不对我说谎。
examplePinyin: Tā cónglái bú duì wǒ shuōhuǎng。
exampleEn: He never lies to me.

en: to think it over carefully; to weigh the pros and cons
exampleZh: 她思前想后，还是决定去。
examplePinyin: Tā sīqián-xiǎnghòu， háishi juédìng qù。
exampleEn: After thinking it over carefully, she still decided to go.

exampleZh: 他低头思索了很久。
examplePinyin: Tā dītóu sīsuǒle hěn jiǔ。
exampleEn: He lowered his head and pondered for a long time.

en: train of thought; thoughts and feelings
exampleZh: 窗外的雨打乱了我的思绪。
examplePinyin: Chuāng wài de yǔ dǎ luànle wǒ de sīxù。
exampleEn: The rain outside the window disturbed my train of thought.

en: to give up hope; to stop hoping
exampleZh: 找了很久找不到，他只好死心。
examplePinyin: Zhǎole hěn jiǔ zhǎo bú dào， tā zhǐhǎo sǐxīn。
exampleEn: After searching for a long time without finding it, he had no choice but to give up hope.
cloze: 找了很久找不到，他只好＿＿。

en: to seem familiar; to have a sense of déjà vu
exampleZh: 这个人看着似曾相识，我可能见过他。
examplePinyin: Zhège rén kànzhe sìcéng-xiāngshí， wǒ kěnéng jiànguo tā。
exampleEn: This person looks familiar; I may have met him before.
cloze: 这个人看着＿＿，我可能见过他。

exampleZh: 听完音乐，他的心情慢慢松弛下来。
examplePinyin: Tīng wán yīnyuè， tā de xīnqíng màn màn sōngchí xiàlái。
exampleEn: After listening to music, his mood slowly relaxed.
cloze: 听完音乐，他的心情慢慢＿＿下来。

en: to complain; to pour out one's troubles
exampleZh: 她心里难受，就找朋友诉苦。
examplePinyin: Tā xīnlǐ nánshòu， jiù zhǎo péngyou sùkǔ。
exampleEn: She felt bad, so she went to a friend to pour out her troubles.

en: to tell; to relate; to pour out (feelings)
exampleZh: 她向朋友诉说着自己的烦恼。
examplePinyin: Tā xiàng péngyou sùshuōzhe zìjǐ de fánnǎo。
exampleEn: She poured out her worries to her friend.
cloze: 她向朋友＿＿着自己的烦恼。

en: to calculate; to scheme; to plot against; to reckon
exampleZh: 他总爱算计别人，大家都不喜欢他。
examplePinyin: Tā zǒng ài suànjì biérén， dàjiā dōu bù xǐhuan tā。
exampleEn: He always likes to scheme against others, so nobody likes him.
cloze: 他总爱＿＿别人，大家都不喜欢他。

en: to follow one's inclinations; to do as one pleases
exampleZh: 放假了，他可以随心所欲地看书。
examplePinyin: Fàngjiàle， tā kěyǐ suíxīnsuǒyù de kàn shū。
exampleEn: On vacation, he can read as much as he pleases.

en: to be greedy; to covet; greedy
exampleZh: 他太贪了，什么都想要。
examplePinyin: Tā tài tānle， shénme dōu xiǎng yào。
exampleEn: He is too greedy and wants everything.

exampleZh: 贪婪的人很难得到满足。
examplePinyin: Tānlán de rén hěn nán dédào mǎnzú。
exampleEn: Greedy people are hard to satisfy.

en: frank; honest; to confess; to admit
exampleZh: 他坦白地说了自己的想法。
examplePinyin: Tā tǎnbái de shuōle zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ。
exampleEn: He frankly stated his own thoughts.

exampleZh: 他对朋友很坦诚，从不骗人。
examplePinyin: Tā duì péngyou hěn tǎnchéng， cóng bú piàn rén。
exampleEn: He is very honest with his friends and never lies to people.

exampleZh: 面对失败，他显得很坦然。
examplePinyin: Miànduì shībài， tā xiǎnde hěn tǎnrán。
exampleEn: Facing failure, he seemed very calm.

exampleZh: 他说话很坦率，从不隐藏。
examplePinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn tǎnshuài， cóng bù yǐncáng。
exampleEn: He speaks very frankly and never hides anything.

en: to state frankly; to admit openly; frank statement
exampleZh: 他坦言自己也曾害怕。
examplePinyin: Tā tǎnyán zìjǐ yě céng hàipà。
exampleEn: He frankly admitted that he had also been afraid.

exampleZh: 他工作太累，常常一个人叹气。
examplePinyin: Tā gōngzuò tài lèi， chángcháng yí gè rén tànqì。
exampleEn: His work is too tiring, and he often sighs alone.

en: to seek; to pursue; to search for
exampleZh: 他一直在探求人生的意义。
examplePinyin: Tā yìzhí zài tànqiú rénshēng de yìyì。
exampleEn: He has always been seeking the meaning of life.

en: to avoid; to evade; to escape from
exampleZh: 遇到困难不能逃避，要想办法解决。
examplePinyin: Yùdào kùnnan bù néng táobì， yào xiǎng bànfǎ jiějué。

examplePinyin: Tīngzhe zhè shǒu yīnyuè， tā wánquán táozuìle。
exampleEn: Listening to this piece of music, she was completely enchanted.
cloze: 听着这首音乐，她完全＿＿了。

exampleZh: 他身上的那种特质让人很难忘记。
examplePinyin: Tā shēn shàng de nà zhǒng tèzhì ràng rén hěn nán wàngjì。
exampleEn: That special quality about him is hard to forget.
cloze: 他身上的那种＿＿让人很难忘记。

en: to be very worried; to be on tenterhooks
exampleZh: 孩子很晚回家，妈妈提心吊胆。
examplePinyin: Háizi hěn wǎn huí jiā， māma tíxīn-diàodǎn。

en: considerate; thoughtful; to show concern for
exampleZh: 她是个很体贴的人，总想着别人。
examplePinyin: Tā shì gè hěn tǐtiē de rén， zǒng xiǎngzhe biérén。
exampleEn: She is a very considerate person and always thinks of others.
cloze: 她是个很＿＿的人，总想着别人。

en: enduring as heaven and earth; everlasting
exampleZh: 祝你们的友情天长地久。
examplePinyin: Zhù nǐmen de yǒuqíng tiāncháng-dìjiǔ。
exampleEn: May your friendship last forever.

exampleZh: 她天生一副好嗓子。
examplePinyin: Tā tiānshēng yí fù hǎo sǎngzi。
exampleEn: She was born with a good voice.

exampleZh: 她笑起来很甜美，大家都喜欢她。
examplePinyin: Tā xiào qǐlái hěn tiánměi， dàjiā dōu xǐhuan tā。
exampleEn: Her smile is very sweet, and everyone likes her.
cloze: 她笑起来很＿＿，大家都喜欢她。

exampleZh: 他们结婚以后生活很甜蜜。
examplePinyin: Tāmen jiéhūn yǐhòu shēnghuó hěn tiánmì。
exampleEn: After they got married, their life has been very sweet.

en: to adjust; to vary (for relief); to balance
exampleZh: 工作太累时，听音乐可以调剂心情。
examplePinyin: Gōngzuò tài lèi shí， tīng yīnyuè kěyǐ tiáojì xīnqíng。
exampleEn: When work is too tiring, listening to music can lift your mood.
cloze: 工作太累时，听音乐可以＿＿心情。

en: to tease; to joke about; to mock playfully
exampleZh: 他喜欢调侃朋友，但从不伤人。
examplePinyin: Tā xǐhuan tiáokǎn péngyou， dàn cóng bù shāng rén。
exampleEn: He likes teasing his friends, but never hurts anyone.
cloze: 他喜欢＿＿朋友，但从不伤人。

exampleZh: 你说的我很同感。
examplePinyin: Nǐ shuō de wǒ hěn tónggǎn。
exampleEn: I feel the same way about what you said.

exampleZh: 看到这些浪费，老人十分痛心。
examplePinyin: Kàn dào zhèxiē làngfèi， lǎorén shífēn tòngxīn。
exampleEn: Seeing this waste, the old man was deeply distressed.

en: clear and logical; speaking in a well-organized way
exampleZh: 他讲得头头是道，大家都信了。
examplePinyin: Tā jiǎng de tóutóu-shìdào， dàjiā dōu xìnle。
exampleEn: He spoke so clearly and logically that everyone believed him.

en: congenial; agreeable (of conversation); to speculate (for profit)
exampleZh: 他们俩聊得很投机，忘了时间。
examplePinyin: Tāmen liǎ liáo de hěn tóujī， wàngle shíjiān。
exampleEn: The two of them chatted so congenially that they forgot the time.
cloze: 他们俩聊得很＿＿，忘了时间。

exampleZh: 他说话太突兀，大家都愣住了。
examplePinyin: Tā shuōhuà tài tūwù， dàjiā dōu lèng zhùle。
exampleEn: He spoke too abruptly, and everyone was stunned.
cloze: 他说话太＿＿，大家都愣住了。

en: to be in vain; futile effort
exampleZh: 雨这么大，再等也是徒劳。
examplePinyin: Yǔ zhème dà， zài děng yě shì túláo。
exampleEn: With the rain this heavy, waiting any longer is futile.

exampleZh: 他最近心情不好，样子很颓废。
examplePinyin: Tā zuìjìn xīnqíng bù hǎo， yàngzi hěn tuífèi。
exampleEn: He's been in a bad mood lately and looks quite dispirited.
cloze: 他最近心情不好，样子很＿＿。

en: to retreat; to shrink back; to flinch
exampleZh: 看到困难，他没有退却。
examplePinyin: Kàn dào kùnnan， tā méiyǒu tuìquè。
exampleEn: Seeing the difficulty, he did not retreat.

en: to shrink back; to flinch; to draw back
exampleZh: 遇到危险时，他从不退缩。
examplePinyin: Yùdào wēixiǎn shí， tā cóng bú tuìsuō。
exampleEn: When facing danger, he never shrinks back.

exampleZh: 他说话吞吞吐吐，好像有事瞒着我。
examplePinyin: Tā shuōhuà tūntūntǔtǔ， hǎoxiàng yǒu shì mánzhe wǒ。
exampleEn: He spoke hesitantly, as if hiding something from me.
cloze: 他说话＿＿，好像有事瞒着我。

en: to blurt out; to say without thinking
exampleZh: 他一着急，就把秘密脱口而出了。
examplePinyin: Tā yì zháojí， jiù bǎ mìmì tuōkǒu’érchūle。
exampleEn: In his panic, he blurted out the secret.

en: to despise; to cast aside with contempt
exampleZh: 大家都唾弃这种不诚实的行为。
examplePinyin: Dàjiā dōu tuòqì zhè zhǒng bù chéngshí de xíngwéi。
exampleEn: Everyone despises this kind of dishonest behavior.
cloze: 大家都＿＿这种不诚实的行为。

en: to mock; to make fun of; to taunt
exampleZh: 别挖苦他了，他已经很难过了。
examplePinyin: Bié wāku tāle， tā yǐjīng hěn nánguòle。
exampleEn: Don't mock him; he's already very upset.

exampleZh: 我妹妹性格很外向。
examplePinyin: Wǒ mèimei xìnggé hěn wàixiàng。
exampleEn: My younger sister has a very outgoing personality.

en: to play with; to toy with; to resort to (tricks)
exampleZh: 请不要玩弄别人的感情。
examplePinyin: Qǐng búyào wánnòng biérén de gǎnqíng。
exampleEn: Please don't toy with other people's feelings.

exampleZh: 他太顽固了，谁的话都不听。
examplePinyin: Tā tài wángù le, shuí de huà dōu bù tīng.
exampleEn: He's too stubborn and listens to no one.

en: to recover; to save (a situation); to win back
exampleZh: 他想挽回这段感情，可是已经晚了。
examplePinyin: Tā xiǎng wǎnhuí zhè duàn gǎnqíng， kěshì yǐjīng wǎnle。
exampleEn: He wants to win back this relationship, but it's already too late.
cloze: 他想＿＿这段感情，可是已经晚了。

en: to feel sorry for; to regret; to sigh over

examplePinyin: Shèng xià de gōngzuò nǐ kěyǐ zìxíng ānpái。
exampleEn: You can arrange the remaining work on your own.
cloze: 剩下的工作你可以＿＿安排。

en: to do something as a mere formality; to go through the motions
exampleZh: 检查要认真，不能走过场。
examplePinyin: Jiǎnchá yào rènzhēn， bù néng zǒu guòchǎng。
exampleEn: Inspections must be serious; you can't just go through the motions.

exampleZh: 这个消息千万别走漏出去。
examplePinyin: Zhège xiāoxi qiānwàn bié zǒulòu chūqù。
exampleEn: Whatever you do, don't let this news leak out.

exampleZh: 这个办法很奏效，问题解决了。
examplePinyin: Zhège bànfǎ hěn zòuxiào， wèntí jiějuéle。
exampleEn: This method worked well, and the problem was solved.
cloze: 这个办法很＿＿，问题解决了。

en: wise and resourceful; full of clever plans
exampleZh: 他足智多谋，很快就解决了难题。
examplePinyin: Tā zúzhì-duōmóu， hěn kuài jiù jiějuéle nántí。
exampleEn: He is resourceful and solved the problem quickly.

en: to obstruct; to hinder; to thwart
exampleZh: 有人想阻挠这个计划，但没有成功。
examplePinyin: Yǒu rén xiǎng zǔnáo zhège jìhuà， dàn méiyǒu chénggōng。
exampleEn: Someone tried to obstruct the plan but did not succeed.
cloze: 有人想＿＿这个计划，但没有成功。

en: to set up; to form; to organize
exampleZh: 公司去年组建了一个新的团队。
examplePinyin: Gōngsī qùnián zǔjiànle yí gè xīn de tuánduì。
exampleEn: The company formed a new team last year.
cloze: 公司去年＿＿了一个新的团队。

en: style of work; way of doing things; conduct
exampleZh: 他的工作作风很认真。
examplePinyin: Tā de gōngzuò zuòfēng hěn rènzhēn。
exampleEn: His work style is very serious.
